evan: heads up — after the eventframe v2 rollout we're seeing a consistent tail latency bump on streaming tool-call traffic, ~30-80ms 95/99 on short responses. started after c3a9bf7 (eventframe: header coalescer + envelope pass).

anita: ugh. which path? tool-call only or generic streaming?

ev an: tool-call heavy only, non-tool streaming looks fine. reproduces on canary and prod reads.

shon: can you paste the flame/prof? maybe the extra envelope pass is reserializing the tool payloads or touching KV cache keys.

evan: here's a quick perf sample from a 1k-request replay (short seq ~20 tokens):
```
PROFILE SUMMARY (toolcall stream)
serialize_envelope            +9.3ms avg
kernel_route_mismatch        +11.8ms on short seq (extra kernel hop)
kv_get_prefetch              +2.1ms (more misses when envelope changes key)
total tail 95 -> +42ms
```

tess: interesting — kernel_route_mismatch means requests were routed to a different kernel variant. did the envelope change the model variant hint?

evan: yes. eventframe v2 now adds a small header: "x-frame-hint" when tool metadata present. router uses that hint for kernel selection fallback. if header present but empty we fallthrough to a slower generic kernel.

anita: that explains the hop. Why is header sometimes empty? race between toolcall attachment and header assembly?

evan: looks like the new envelope builder does a second serialization pass that can race with KV prefill; on a hit it rewrites the key ordering which changes the routing key used by kernel autoselect.

ci-bot: CI perf guard: eventframe-coalesce-integration increased median latency by 18% and 95p by 34% on nightly replay. See: https://ci.example/3109

shon: OK, bisect time. suspect change landed in two commits: c3a9bf7 (envelope pass) and d4f0e2a (header hint plumbing). I'd revert the envelope pass first.

tess: +1 revert envelope pass is safe and low surface. We can gate the hint plumbing until we have deterministic header generation.

infra-bot: rollout hold applied to canary pool: rollout/hold/eventframe-v2 by shon :warning:

anita: for the revert, add a small test that ensures header generation is deterministic and that routing key is stable across prefill/serialize. Add a perf guard too.

evan: I'll open the PR and attach the perf replay with before/after. planning to revert c3a9bf7 and run a 10k replay.

shon: if revert reduces 95p by >20ms we ship revert to canary ASAP. If not, fallback is to make router ignore x-frame-hint until it's stable (cheap change).

tess: also add a short-term mitigation: if kernel_autoselect picks a different kernel mid-request, prefer the original kernel if latency-sensitive flag is set. low-risk, but needs a small runtime patch.

evan: noted. I'll triage order: 1) revert envelope pass PR, 2) regen perf replay, 3) gate hint plumbing behind feature flag, 4) runtime prefer-original-kernel fallback.

anita: thanks. please paste replay results here when done. :eyes:

ci-bot: created issue PERF-1182: "eventframe v2 envelope serialization causes kernel routing mismatches" (assignee: evan).

infra-bot: canary notified, traffic diverted to previous version during revert PR testing.

shon: lul. good catch. adding a note to the release: don't enable eventframe-v2 for toolcall-heavy customers until hints are stable.

evan: will do. opening PR now -> https://git.example/revert/3120 (wip)

tess: if anyone's free later I can pair on the deterministic header test.

anita: i'll help with the perf harness and compare kernel-selection traces.

shon: sweet. keep the thread updated.
